title: Transfer Students

description: Students who currently study at another school in the U.S. and want to change their schools.

category.title: Application Steps
lists: Apply to MLI (Fill out on-line application)
description: Students should apply to MLI 1 or 2 months before their desired program starting date. It is best to speak with a student advisor at MLI after submitting an on-line application to confirm the transfer process as it can be complicated depending on your situation.

category.title: Cancellation Policy
description: The enrollment fee of $150, will be charged at the time of application. The enrollment fee is non-refundable regardless if a visa application is rejected or enrollment is cancelled.

category.title: After submitting your application
description: After students submit the on-line application, MLI will process the application and send a the link for iMLI (Each Student's on-line application page). Students can follow the continued application process stated on the iMLI.

applyOnline.title: Apply Online
description:
Fill out the on-line application.
Contact us via e-mail with any questions.
